ideas.pitch: A clinical-grade emergency triage application using browser-based rPPG heart rate sensing and localized multilingual voice input for fast-paced hospital intakes.
ideas.problem_statement: Healthcare & MedTech domain challenge for rapid triage and low-resource medical data collection.
ideas.title: MediScan-IIITK: Clinical Triage and Vital Estimation Platform
ideas.why_it_could_win: Directly mirrors a proven winner by delivering a working live demo using computer vision and rPPG sensors, addressing the judges' priority for practical implementation in high-stress environments.

ideas.pitch: An AI-powered satellite monitoring system that detects unauthorized land use changes and early drought risks in agricultural sectors using spatial raster data.
ideas.problem_statement: Agriculture & Climate Tech domain challenge regarding climate resilience and environmental monitoring.
ideas.title: AgriSentry-Sat: Satellite Land Compliance & Crop Risk Monitor
ideas.why_it_could_win: Leverages the architectural patterns of satellite land compliance systems that previously won runner-up awards at technical hackathons, appealing strongly to judges looking for scalable environmental impact.

ideas.pitch: An IoT-integrated web platform that ingests aquatic sensor telemetry to forecast harmful algal bloom risks days in advance using lightweight regression models.
ideas.problem_statement: Smart Cities & IoT domain challenge addressing environmental safety and resource management.
ideas.title: AquaWatch IoT: Predictive Algal Bloom Early Warning System
ideas.why_it_could_win: Follows a proven IoT competition-winning blueprint by combining predictive analytics with actionable visualization dashboards for municipal authorities.

ideas.pitch: An AI-powered multi-agent student support system using LangGraph and localized RAG pipelines to dynamically generate tailored learning paths and homework evaluations.
ideas.problem_statement: Education & EdTech domain challenge addressing personalized student mentorship at scale.
ideas.title: EduMentor Graph: Multi-Agent Personalized Learning Companion
ideas.why_it_could_win: Adapts a first-place hackathon architecture utilizing multi-agent orchestration, providing a deeply interactive and technically robust system that stands out in the EdTech track.

ideas.pitch: A voice-first desktop agent that monitors live audio streams locally to protect senior citizens from targeted social engineering and financial email scams.
ideas.problem_statement: Social Good & Governance domain challenge protecting vulnerable populations from digital fraud.
ideas.title: SeniorShield Voice: Scam-Detection Voice Agent for Elders
ideas.why_it_could_win: Replicates a winning agentic hackathon design focused on vulnerable demographics, offering a compelling social impact narrative backed by real-time speech processing.
